senses.gloss: m. (חמט, cmp. חמץ, to be salty, bitter, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, p. 205ᵇ) ḥumton, a sandy soil containing salty substances and used for the preservation of wheat.
units: Sabb. 31ᵃ קב ח׳ (Ms. M. חוּמְטִין) a Kab of h powder.—ארץ ח׳ pr. n. Land of Ḥ., a district of northern Palestine.
<cite ref="Shabbat 54a:4">Ib. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ ח׳ וכ׳</he> the district presented to Hiram was the Land of H.
